items.desc: Minimal reading-focused blog. Fills all panes.
items.html:
◈ FIELDNOTES
EssaysNotesAbout

ESSAY — 12 MIN

The quiet power of
boring interfaces

The best UI is the one you never notice. Here's how restraint became our sharpest design tool.

Every pixel on this page had to argue for its existence. The ones that couldn't make their case were deleted. What remains is fast, calm, and — we hope — invisible.

Constraint is a feature

When you limit the palette to three accents and one typeface, every decision gets easier and every page gets more coherent. Systems beat inspiration.

“Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.”

Ship the boring version first. Polish is what you add when the boring version already works.

#design#systems#restraint
© 2026 FieldnotesRSS · Archive
